summary:
CEILING AIR DEVICES TO BUY — 31 grilles/diffusers total (plus 3 ceiling exhaust fans).

SUPPLY — 28 ceiling diffusers, 6,550 CFM total. All Price, white, 4-way fixed pattern:
• Type A — 5 ea, SCD, 6" round neck, 24x24 lay-in panel (75/75/75/90/130 CFM)
• Type B — 4 ea, SCD, 8" round neck, 24x24 lay-in panel (140/140/150/150)
• Type C — 15 ea, SCD, 10" round neck, 24x24 lay-in panel (200 to 375 CFM ea)
• Type D — 1 ea, SCD, 12" round neck, 24x24 lay-in panel (500) — Kilns 115
• Type J — 3 ea, SMD, 12x12 face w/ 8" round neck, SURFACE-MOUNT flanged frame (150/150/175) — toilets/showers, hard ceilings
All SCD units (A–D) are louvered-face 4-cone with full-faced louvers, factory-insulated backpan, and a radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9 or equal). Type J is louvered-face high-capacity with an opposed-blade damper.

RETURN/EXHAUST IN THE CEILING — 3 grilles:
• Type F — 3 ea, Price 80, 24"x24" all-aluminum 1/2"x1/2"x1/2" eggcrate, core-only panel, lay-in, white. One at the FCU-1 return in MP Room 119; two in Mtg Room 106 (Note 4: provide a new 24x24 lined 1" plenum atop each).
Plus 1 ea 14x14 eggcrate, Price model 82, mounted in the soffit with insect screen on the back (Note 19) — untagged, easy to miss.

CEILING EXHAUST FANS (integral grille — do NOT order grilles for these): EF-1 and EF-2 Greenheck SP-A700 @ 450 CFM, EF-3 Greenheck SP-B90 @ 75 CFM. All are direct-drive centrifugal ceiling fans with integral grille, flapper BD damper, cord/plug, factory grille-mounted motion sensor and speed controller.

NOT CEILING — don't forget these 15 wall grilles on the same sheet (they're in the same schedule): Type H, 3 ea 18x8 Price 520D double-deflection sidewall supply @ 550 CFM ea; Type I, 4 ea 14x8 Price 520D sidewall supply @ 450 CFM ea; Type E, 4 ea ~30x18 Price 95 sidewall return; Type G, 4 ea 36x36 Price 95 sidewall transfer grille (2 wall openings, one grille each face, top el. 14'-8" AFF). All primecoat only — Note 13 requires 2 coats of field paint, color per architect. Types E and I carry an asterisk: field-verify the exact grille dimension before ordering (the engineer could not measure the existing openings — Note 7). Sidewall supply total is another 3,450 CFM.

Basis: M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan) for the device count — 46 tagged devices total, tallied by tag hexagon; M601 for the grille, exhaust fan and equipment schedules and legend; MD101 confirms every removed grille is replaced with new (nothing salvaged/reused). M101 is the only new-work mechanical plan in the set, so this is the whole building. Coordinate final locations with the architectural RCP per M601 General Note 3.
